items.title: Harry "Sweets" Edison interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe. We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a special day for us because we’re here today with one of the kings of the trumpet, Sweets Edison. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you.

ctx.x: Jazz lovers can hear Sweets on hundreds of records with these various ensembles and under his own name. Mr. Edison will receive an Honorary Doctorate from Hamilton College in May of 1996.
He was interviewed by Monk Rowe in Los Angeles on September 3, 1995.
